hooks.name: kiro-folder-guard
hooks.description: Before a write, check that .kiro still exists, that no .gitignore line hides it, and that LICENSE is present. Exit code 2 refuses the tool call. This is the automated version of the contest rule 'dossier /.kiro à la racine et absent du .gitignore': the cheapest possible mistake to make, and the only one that disqualifies the project.
